text:
Alex T.: heads-up — proposing we add a per-tenant `deprec-preview` mode in the console that simulates routing + quota impact before flipping a tenant to v2-only. show: expected 95th p latency, token-usage delta, fallback rate to v1 variants, and an estimated cost delta. quick feedback?

Maria G.: love the safety net idea. can we also surface which routes will be forced into compat-shim (header->param mapping) so customers see functional diffs?

TJ: yes — and add a 'live probe' toggle that runs a small sample of real traffic (1%) through v2 to catch regressions. results shown with a tiny A/B diff table.

Kevin L.: main risk is quota math. when we simulate, use tenant's actual batching patterns + KV cache hit rate. naive per-request multiply will overestimate token delta.

Beth S.: agree with Kevin. console should fetch recent trace histograms (seq len distribution) and mimic batching. we already ingest that telemetry in metrics pipeline.

Alex T.: right — plan: preview pipeline will pull last-7d seq histogram + avg batch size + prefix-KV hit rate. run model-cost estimator to give token & latency delta. show a confidence band.

Maria G.: UI stuff: add a diff view with three columns: baseline (v1), preview (v2 simulated), and actionables (what to change: header mapping, function-calls, model variant pins).

TJ: about header mapping — let's be explicit. example mapping snippet we discussed earlier:
```
# detection: prefer X-Client-Version, fall back to api-version param
if headers['X-Client-Version'] >= '2': route = 'v2'
else if params['api_version'] == '2': route = 'v2'
else route = 'v1-compat'
```
We should show how preview would apply that to customer's traffic sample.

Kevin L.: also show quota impact when we enable strict routing (no fallback). customers often forget fallback keeps token cost down. preview should have a checkbox: "assume no fallback" to show worst-case.

Beth S.: engineering request: we need a non-prod sandbox mode for tenants where preview runs actual model variants but writes logs to a tenant-preview index and never bills. QA can validate outputs.

Alex T.: good call. proposal: two preview flavors — "telemetry-only" (simulate using recorded traces) and "sandbox-live" (replay small live traffic to v2, write outputs to preview index, no billing).

Maria G.: can console show a per-route heatmap of compatibility signals? e.g., routes with higher function-calling usage or structured outputs should get flagged with a "likely break" badge.

TJ: yes. we'll use eval heuristics: function call ratio, presence of structured tokens, average response size. add a simple risk score 0-100.

Kevin L.: operationally: add guardrails so admins can't flip everyone at once. default rollout controls: max-tenants-per-day, ramp %, and a rollback button with immediate switchback.

Beth S.: telemetry hooks: for the preview run emit metrics tagged with preview_id and tenant_id so we can query side-by-side. also emit sampling traces for failed conversions.

deploy-bot: shadow-deploy finished for tenant "acme-corp" preview id=pp-2026-03-20-001 — sampled 1200 requests; 1.8% unexpected-exceptions; artifacts at https://deploys/revisions/pp-2026-03-20-001

console-bot: preview-report generated for tenant acme-corp: risk_score=42; estimated token increase=+3.4% (CI ±0.6); expected 95p latency +28ms. show in console under Tenant > acme-corp > Previews.

Alex T.: next steps: (1) spec API endpoints for preview control + results (simple REST), (2) lightweight estimator lib (python + go), (3) console UX mocks. I'll draft RFC and link here.

Maria G.: sgtm. please include sample responses for the REST API (preview start/stop, report payload).

TJ: I'll take the estimator PoC (go) and wire the sampling probe.

Kevin L.: I'll own quota-simulation and adding the "no-fallback" toggle in the estimator.

Beth S.: I'll mock the console screens and heatmap widgets.

Alex T.: thanks — posting RFC draft in ~2h. :thumbsup:
